results.title: LOL4X Viral Video Trend Explained: Editing Tips and Creator Strategies
results.description: The "LOL4X" viral trend sees creators accelerating comedic short-form videos to four times their normal speed to boost viewer retention and re-watches. Success relies on front-loaded hooks, bold central captions, deliberate speed shifts, and pitch-shifted audio. This hyper-fast formatting reflects a growing shift toward high-density social media content.
